text:
olivia: quick Q — where do I find prefix cache hit rate metrics and the dashboard to slice by model/route? we started seeing more misses in prod this morning and want to triage.

raj: Grafana -> Observability -> 'Prefix Cache' dashboard has the per-route panels. quick link: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/8f3a2b/prefix-cache-overview (open only inside corp VPN). panel names: prefix_hit_rate, prefix_requests, prefix_evictions.

maddy: if you're triaging, also check traces for long tail latency — sometimes prefix miss spikes line up with slow model loads. use service:runtime traces and filter tag:cache=prefix.

olivia: thanks — can you paste the prometheus query you use for the hit rate? want to add to an ad-hoc note.

raj: sure, our canonical calc is:

```
(sum(rate(prefix_cache_hit_total[5m])) by (route, model)) / (sum(rate(prefix_cache_request_total[5m])) by (route, model))
```

raj: that returns a fraction per route+model. multiply by 100 for percent in Grafana. for noisy routes we also look at absolute request counts: `sum(rate(prefix_cache_request_total[5m])) by (route)` so we don't alert on tiny traffic.

olivia: perfect. any log search to correlate misses to backend errors?

maddy: search in logs: `service:runtime AND component:cache AND message:(miss OR miss_count OR prefetch)` or in Splunk: `index=runtime source=cache "prefix_miss" | stats count by route, model`. also look for lines with `prefetch_failed` — that often explains sudden miss rate increases.

jorge: fyi, alert currently set to trigger when prefix_hit_rate < 0.6 for 5m. that's noisy during deploys / cold starts. i'm going to propose changing it to 0.7 with a 10m eval window and add a mute for the next 2h while we validate.

olivia: sounds good. can you make the change and post the new alert rule? i want to link it in the incident note.

jorge: will do. i'll push the rule change to monitoring repo and ping when it's live. also adding a note to ignore routes with <50 reqs/5m.

sre-bot: Alert update requested by jorge: monitoring/alerts/prefix-cache/low-hit-rate -> proposed threshold 0.7, eval_window 10m, min_traffic 50 reqs/5m. awaiting PR.

olivia: awesome — once that's in, i'll run a dashboard walkthrough with the infra oncall and we can check whether prefetch tuning helped. thanks all. :thumbsup:

raj: if you want a quick ad-hoc chart per model, i can share a short dashboard with the perc90/perc99 hit rate too.

maddy: one more note — add a tag in traces for prefetch_source (local|remote) so we can quickly separate warm vs remote prefetch misses. we did that in staging last month and it helped.

olivia: good call. adding to follow-up action items.

jorge: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/mon/alerts/pull/342 — includes threshold bump, eval window, and min traffic filter. i'll merge once ci passes.

olivia: thanks!
